import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze as A
import z3

seed=int(sys.argv[1]); ns=int(sys.argv[2]); mode=sys.argv[3]
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False, nsnap=ns)
inst = A._parse_request(req)

orig_min = A.Model._minimize
orig_max = A.Model._maximize
def min2(self, expr, lo):
    s = self.solver
    hi = self._model_value(expr)
    if hi <= lo: return lo
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2 if mode == 'bin' else (hi - 1 if self._d < 6 else (lo+hi)//2)
        self._d += 1
        s.push(); s.add(expr <= mid); r = s.check()
        if r == z3.sat:
            v = self._grab(expr); s.pop(); hi = v
        else:
            s.pop(); lo = mid + 1
    return lo
def max2(self, expr, hi):
    s = self.solver
    lo = self._model_value(expr)
    if lo >= hi: return hi
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2 if mode == 'bin' else (lo + 1 if self._d < 6 else (lo+hi+1)//2)
        self._d += 1
        s.push(); s.add(expr >= mid); r = s.check()
        if r == z3.sat:
            v = self._grab(expr); s.pop(); lo = v
        else:
            s.pop(); hi = mid - 1
    return lo
A.Model._d = 0
if mode in ('bin','desc'):
    A.Model._minimize = min2
    A.Model._maximize = max2
if mode.startswith('p:'):
    pname, pval = mode[2:].split('=')
    orig_init = A.Model.__init__
    def init2(self, inst):
        z3.Solver.set = None
        orig_init(self, inst)
    A.Model._minimize.__self__ if False else None
    # patch solver creation
    src_init = A.Model.__init__
    def init3(self, inst):
        import z3 as _z
        orig_init(self, inst)
    A.Model.__init__ = orig_init

t0=time.time()
res = A.analyze(inst, req['id'])
print('%s nsnap=%d mode=%s total=%.2f k=%s' % (sys.argv[0].split('/')[-1], ns, mode, time.time()-t0, res.get('min_faults')), flush=True)
EOF
